customManagers.description: Watch Garden Linux upstream — a bump PR = run hack/vendor-upstream.sh + the docs/73 GL train, never a plain merge

packageRules.description: The vendored GL version never automerges — it drives the docs/73 image train

Base images here are vendored from upstream Garden Linux (cert/Containerfile, build tooling) and track GL_TAG via hack/vendor-upstream.sh — never Renovate. Pinning them diverges from upstream (confirmed: upstream cert/Containerfile is FROM debian:stable at 2150.6.0) and gets clobbered on the next vendor sync.
